lines.en: Ahh, snow.
Frozen water droplets guaranteed to fill the hearts of children with glee as they look outside of the window and realize there’s even a slight possibility of skipping school for a day.
I try to recall a time in my life where those kinds of thoughts would find their way into my head.
Now, any time I look up and see something like this, I just think of it as an inconvenience.
And so I take a moment to reflect on how things may have changed for me over the years.
But that moment is cut short the second I bump into Yumi.
: Yo.
: Your bridge is a little further that way. You’re missing out on quality target practice.
: Not like there are any fuckin’ cars driving around in this weather anyway.
: And hey! I don’t just spend every waking moment spitting on cars, asshole. I’ve got better shit to do.
: Oh? Don’t tell me you went and found a job without me.
: Nah. I haven’t even really looked since that whole...fiasco the other night.
: Then what is this apparent “better shit” you have to do that takes precedence over tormenting drivers and finding a way to put food on the table?
: And don’t say “avoiding me” either because it’s clear that you’ve at least temporarily given up on that.
: Well...right now, I ain’t doing shit. But in a couple hours or whatever, I’m supposed to be meeting Chika around here to help her pick out a Christmas present for the brat.
: Chinami doesn’t need any Christmas presents. She has both a cell phone and a business now. Her life is complete.
: Sorry to be the bearer of bad news but I’m almost confident that business doesn’t actually exist.
: Almost?
: Yeah, well, you never fuckin’ know with her.
: So what then? You’re just planning on standing around here for hours until it’s time to meet Chika?
: What the fuck else am I gonna do? Ask your [niece] to hang out? Go bowling with the fucking weird ponytail girl?
: We have several weird ponytail girls now, so I’m not really sure which one you’re referring to.
: The watermelon one.
: Oh, Maya.
: Yeah, don’t hang out with her. You two forming an alliance would be extremely irritating for me.
: But why not use this time to get back to job hunting if you don’t know what else to do?
: You have me now. And you’re wearing your nice clothes and everything.
: My other clothes are fucking fine! Eat a dick!
: Sure. But these ones are...more fine.
: Ugh...do we really have to do this job shit right now?
: Because if I wind up running into someone I know for a second time in a row, I’m just going to give up on ever finding a job.
: Would you rather continue standing here together? We could try talking about our feelings. We’re both very good at that.
: Can I talk about how shitty it feels constantly being around you? Because I could probably kill a few hours that way.
: I mean...that’s typically what you talk about anyway. But if that’s going to be your attitude, I’ll put my foot down right now and start the job hunt without your consent.
: What? You doing something without my consent? As if that would ever happen.
: Hey, correct me if I’m wrong, but I was able to successfully restrain myself the last time you gave me an opening to go against that.
: Congrats on having the slightest shred of self control imaginable. It’s almost like you’re a real human being now.
: Are any of us truly real, Yumi?
: You know what? Fine. At the risk of you getting all fucking philosophical, sure. Let’s go job hunting.
: It might be fun trying to set the world record for refused applications or failed interviews or however I manage to fuck things up this time.
: Yumi, you’ve been rejected by like three places. That’s really not that bad.
: Plenty of adults get rejected by far more than that before finding a place to work.
: Really?! Because the fact that you were hired by a school makes me pretty fucking doubtful of that!
: Touché.
: Luckily for you, though, I have an idea of a place that I can’t imagine rejecting you at all.
: What? Really? Well, then why the fuck did you wait until right now to tell me about it?
: Anyway, follow me.
: Yo! I asked you a fuckin’ question! Don’t just start walking away!
The truth is that I’m not 100%% confident Yumi will just be allowed to work here-
But, at the same time, I’m not really sure if she’d want to either.
But hey, if she’s truly desperate for work, she should be willing to go a little outside of her comfort zone.
And what better place to do that than one of my favorite local businesses that I’ve been all but banned from shopping at?
: Wha-
: Where the fuck do you think you’re taking me, creep?!
: Just let it happen, Yumi.
: Is this a fucking porn shop?!
: I like to think of it as an “adult entertainment center.”
: That’s just a fancy way to say it’s a porn shop, you fucking lunatic! I’m pretty sure I’m not even allowed to be in here!
: Since when do you care about anything you’re allowed to do?
: Since there’s fucking porn involved! I can’t work here!
: Wha-
: What is the meaning of this?! Are you out of your fucking mind?!
: Do you have any job applications laying around?
: No! Leave!
: And why on earth are you with Yumi of all people?
: Hm? You know me?
: I ain’t ever seen you a day in my fuckin’ life.
: Go put your glasses on.
: Ugh...
: The fuck is even going on right now?
: Nothing really. This is actually a pretty normal day for me, all things considered.
: Oh, no fucking way.
: Leave. Now. Both of you.
: The service here really isn’t all that great, so clearly there’s a chance for you as an employee after all.
: Wait, wait, wait, wait, wait...
: You mean to tell me the fucking class rep works at a porn shop? Is this some kind of prank?
: Her family actually owns the place.
: Yeah. Sure they do. I ain’t fallin’ for that shit. Now, where’s the real job?
: What’s going on? We haven’t had this many people in the store since last Valentine’s Day.
: And who’s this? Another [niece] that I’m not finding out about until right now?
: Maybe a mistress? Hooker? You two can hang out in the back room at a discounted rate, but you’ve gotta be quick since I need to clean the glass sometime before night comes.
: That is a classmate of mine, mother.
: Oh. Well, we don’t have a student discount here, so you’ll have to pay full price. Still be quick, though.
: She’s actually looking for a job, Maki. And I figured somewhere like this might be a good opportunity for her.
: You want to sell porn?
: Uhh...not really?
: I’ve gotta say, not a good start, Sensei.
: Maybe you two just need some one-on-one time together? I’m sure if anyone is able to get Yumi to open up the wonderful world of adult entertainment, it’s you.
: Wonderful, because that gives me the chance to talk to you. Alone.
: Works for me! Though, I am a little sad because Makoto gets the family discount and I was really banking on some of that sweet, sweet back room revenue.
: Uhh...
: Wait, this...isn’t just a prank then?
: What are you doing?! Why are you here?! Why did you bring Yumi here?!
: You know how important it is for me to keep my involvement with this place hidden!
: From Yumi? What’s she going to do about it?
: Oh, I don’t know- use it as leverage against me?
: I’m pretty sure that Chika’s already seen me here and that's bad enough! Now, the entirety of Dorm #1 knows!
: Alternatively, you could just hire her. Then she’d be forced to keep it a secret as well.
: But why here?!
: There are a million other places hiring [teenager]s! Why would you bring her to arguably the worst of all of those places?! Especially when you know I don’t want you to?!
: Well?
: I thought it’d be funny.
: You fucking-
: Besides, Yumi’s been through a lot lately. I figured something lighthearted like a trip to the local porn shop might brighten things up a bit for her.
: You...
: Certainly have a strange outlook on what sort of things would brighten up someone’s day.
: Why not just...buy her flowers and give her a shoulder massage if you’re so worried about her?
: I also thought I could get here before your shift started and actually purchase something from your mom.
: Why?...Why do I like you so much?
: So...you think you’ve got what it takes to be a porn saleswoman...
: What? The fuck are you talkin’ about, lady? I just told you I don’t wanna fuckin’ work here.
: Are you sure you don’t want to work here? Or are you just saying that?
: Because, on the outside, a job like this might seem like a cesspool of debauchery...an unholy paradise of poon-
: But what it really is...is a place where everyone is accepted! Where everyone is loved!
: Where no fetish is discarded! And no book is to be judged by its cover!
: Places like this shop are one of the last bastions of hope-
: I’m sorry, what was your name?
: Yumi.
: Well, Yumi...stick with me and I can guarantee you’ll see the light.
: I know it might all be a little too intimidating to take in at once, but this job truly is rewarding. People like my daughter and me are the unsung heroes of retail, you know.
: No one likes to admit it, but as far as in-house sales go, no one is more likely to change a customer’s life than people like us.
: You’re a cute, [young]girl. I’m not sure what kind of family you come from or if they’d accept their daughter working a job like this, but I’d be willing to talk to them if you need me to.
: Yeah...You don’t have to worry about talkin’ to my family or any shit like that.
: I still don’t know how I feel about workin’ in a place like this and, honestly, I still think it’s creepy as shit.
: But all that stuff about it bein’ a place where you can’t judge books by their cover...doesn’t sound all that bad, I guess.
: Right?! We’re all equals here! Me, you, and even the one woman who comes in once a week and buys nothing but vintage porno DVD’s starting with the letter Y!
: This is the holy grail, Yumi! I don’t know how much I can pay you, but if you’re willing to negotiate, I can have you start as early as next Monday night.
: Uhh...wait a second. I didn’t really agree to-
: I just need to know what kind of experience you have first.
: Does blood make you nauseous? What about comically large gangbangs or incest?
: Any hard limit on the size of a schlong before you start feeling nervous or worried about the pain and have to look away from the girl (Or guy) getting her (Or his) brains railed out?
: Also, can you agree to keep things confidential on the off chance that you find a family member or other loved one in a video?

: Because sometimes, whether we like it or not, people are forced to do things they’re not very proud of for money- and as a retailer in this industry, you need to be willing to be confidential about-
: Wait! No! Don’t leave!
: Excuse me, Makoto, but I think I have to go chase after Yumi now.
: Don’t bother! And never even think about bringing me somewhere as sketchy as this ever again!
: It’s not sketchy! It’s perfectly natural!
: I am a good person! I’m making the world a better place, one orgasm at a time!
: MOM! STOP SAYING THAT!
Yumi is able to get away from me and, judging by the abruptness of her exit, I think it’s safe to assume she has no plan on working with the Miyamuras any time soon.
But hey, at least this time she made the conscious decision to not work somewhere instead of just being flat-out rejected.
Yumi’s affection has increased to [yumi_love]!
